newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai property, finance firms delays bond payments.
newsitem.headline: Thai property, finance firms delays bond payments.

text.p: Juldis Develop Plc and Kiatnakin Finance and Securities Plc have missed interest payments on domestic bonds, market regulators said in a statement on Monday.

The Bond Dealers Club of Thailand said property developer Juldis missed its interest payment on Monday and the firm sought a six-month delay in meeting its obligation of paying both interest and principle on its domestic debentures.
"Juldis has asked for a delay on interest payment on its number one bond due on August 18 until February 18," the statement said.
